title: Adds support for multiple (partial) payments on invoices
changed: Invoice.payment_intent, charge, paid, paid_out_of_band, application_fee_amount, transfer_data removed
literal expand entries through a removed field, such as 'latest_invoice.payment_intent'
refund request parameter removed from creditNotes.create
refund query parameter removed from creditNotes.preview and listPreviewLineItems
reason: Not mapped: the adapter names GET /v1/credit_notes/preview `creditNotes.preview.preview` from its URL, and removedRequestParameters compares request bodies only, so the removed query parameter is reported nowhere.

changed: Invoice.payment_intent, charge, paid, paid_out_of_band, application_fee_amount, transfer_data removed
literal expand entries through a removed field, such as 'latest_invoice.payment_intent'
parts.how: findRemovedProperties (specifications.ts) reports the removed field and analyzeRepository (analyzer.ts) reports each traced read as a confirmed finding; STRIPE_MOVE_REVIEW (stripe-field-moves.ts) appends the named Stripe reason where it has one. No rule edits the read, so a deterministic patch leaves it unresolved and the AI patch path (run.ts aiFindings, ai-patches.ts proposeAiPatch) receives it. Expand entries are reported by removedExpandPaths (stripe-expand-paths.ts) and stay unresolved the same way.

changed: refund request parameter removed from creditNotes.create
parts.reason: removedRequestParameters (request-removals.ts) finds the removed top-level body parameter on the mapped operation; analyzeRepository marks each traced call that still sends it with requestParameter, and migrationReviewReason (migration-review.ts) stops automatic migration, AI and publication with REMOVED_REQUEST_PARAMETER_REVIEW_REASON.

changed: refund query parameter removed from creditNotes.preview and listPreviewLineItems
parts.reason: Not mapped: the adapter names GET /v1/credit_notes/preview `creditNotes.preview.preview` from its URL, and removedRequestParameters compares request bodies only, so the removed query parameter is reported nowhere.
Behaviour change with no difference in the recorded stripe/openapi contracts, so Refit has no signal for it.
